original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 Wake-up Type metadata equals the platform-approved enumerated value and persists after reboot; this row does not functionally exercise a wake source.
original_method: Collect complete Type 1, parse the Wake-up Type enumeration and raw context, compare with the platform power-history/baseline rule, run the approved reboot and repeat without triggering a separate sleep, power-off or wake event.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected enumeration and reboot plan. Metadata collection/comparison is automatable; no physical wake action belongs to this case.
required_inputs: Definition of whether value reflects last wake or configured type
safety_requirements: Do not trigger sleep, power-off, WoL, RTC or physical wake under this row.
Preserve full Type 1/errors and enumeration decoding.
Stop on semantic ambiguity, unexpected state drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 1/tool/platform evidence, decode the enumerated metadata, compare before/after approved reboot and flag scope mismatch.
Do not stimulate a wake source, alter power policy or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected enumeration/meaning and metadata-only scope.
Interpret firmware-history semantics and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but filtered-only output, hidden errors and insecure transport are weak; the command must not be expanded into a wake test.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 1 and version/errors using approved transport, then parse only Wake-up Type before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, Wake-up Type scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve raw and decoded Wake-up Type, bind it to firmware/platform semantics and compare across the source-required reboot without adding any wake stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Wake-up Type expectation and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit enumeration/semantics and prevents scope creep into a physical wake test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves the metadata check exactly.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A reported wake type does not prove that a corresponding wake source functions.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different expected enum based on its boot/wake history. That does not authorize a functional wake test or alter the master source.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected enum/semantics, platform and tool versions
Raw pre-reboot Type 1 plus decoded Wake-up Type
Engineer verdict with metadata-only scope stated

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion define a metadata check; no wake stimulus is requested.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field/method are clear; expected enumeration/package/window are readiness inputs.
